name: Blinded
effect: −4 to all Attack and Observe rolls. Cannot target unseen.
removed: end of next turn or healing.

name: Prone
effect: −2 to Attack. Melee attackers gain +2 vs you. Moving costs 1 extra Action.
removed: spend 1 Action or Reaction.

name: Restrained
effect: Cannot move. −2 to Evasion and Deflect.
removed: opposed Strength roll.

name: Frightened
effect: −2 to all rolls while source is visible.
removed: source removed, or Inspire/Resist vs DC 12.

name: Stunned
effect: Lose all Actions and Reactions this round. Deflect only.
removed: end of next turn.

name: Exhausted
effect: −2 to all rolls. Cumulative.
removed: Full Recovery clears 1 level.

name: Poisoned
effect: −1 to all Body rolls. 1 Stamina box per round until treated.
removed: Survive DC 14 (requires a Full Rest to clear), or time (clears after 1 scene without exposure).

name: Burning
effect: 1 Stamina box per round (Energy damage). Spreads to adjacent on Nat 1.
removed: 1 Action, or immersion in water.

name: Silenced
effect: Cannot speak. Using Powers requires Concentrate DC 10 (Magic Overlay).
removed: end of effect or Dispel.

name: Exposed
effect: All incoming attacks gain +2.
removed: take a Defend or Evasion action.

name: Bleeding
effect: 1 Stamina box per round (Physical damage). Does not spread.
removed: Survive DC 10, or Full Rest.

name: Charmed
effect: Treats the source as a trusted ally. Cannot willingly attack the charmer. −4 to all social rolls made against the charmer.
removed: charmer attacks the charmed character, or Resist vs DC 14.

name: Confused
effect: Must succeed on a Willpower check DC 12 at the start of each turn or direct all Actions at a random adjacent character (1–3 = nearest ally, 4–6 = nearest enemy).
removed: end of effect, or Inspire/Resist vs DC 14.

name: Dazed
effect: Lose 1 Action per round (minimum 1 Action always remains). Lighter than Stunned — the character can still act.
removed: end of next turn.

name: Deafened
effect: −2 to all Observe rolls. Automatically fails hearing-based checks. Cannot benefit from verbal commands, Inspire, or social actions requiring speech.
removed: end of effect or Heal DC 10.

name: Slowed
effect: Movement costs 1 extra Action per range band. Cannot use the free movement granted by Actions.
removed: end of scene, or Heal DC 10.

name: Removed
effect: The character has lost contact with the source of their power. This is always a narrative event — a mage in a null-magic zone, a warrior stripped of their equipment and gifts, a spiritual leader whose faith has been shattered. Three variants exist, one per Domain. All three may apply simultaneously.

name: Removed (Body)
effect: Cannot add any Body Ability Score to rolls — all Body-based rolls use d20 only. Incoming Stamina damage is doubled. Physical skills may still be attempted but without Ability Score backing.
removed: narrative restoration of the physical source — GM call only.

name: Removed (Mind)
effect: Cannot cast Powers or spend Mana. All Mind-based rolls suffer −4. Mana pool still takes damage normally but boxes cannot be spent voluntarily.
removed: narrative restoration of the mental or arcane source — GM call only.

name: Removed (Spirit)
effect: Cannot use Spirit-based skills or Powers. Cannot spend Resolve. All Spirit-based rolls suffer −4. Social actions default to bare Ability Score only — no Skill bonus applies.
removed: narrative restoration of the spiritual or emotional source — GM call only.

name: Concealed
effect: Partially obscured by fog, darkness, or cover. Attackers must succeed on a DC 11 Acuity check before rolling — on failure, the attack misses regardless of the roll.
removed: obscurement cleared, or attacker moves to Close range.

name: Doomed
effect: A powerful curse or divine judgment reduces the character’s Broken threshold by 1 per Doomed level. Doomed 1 means Broken occurs at box 14. Doomed 2 at box 13. Maximum Doomed 3. At Doomed 3 + Broken, the character dies.
removed: 1 level per ritual cleansing (Channel DC 16); Doomed 3 requires divine intervention.

name: Drained
effect: Life force has been sapped. Pool maximum reduced by 2 per Drained level (maximum Drained 3). Existing marked boxes remain; the ceiling drops.
removed: 1 level per Full Rest with magical healing. Does not clear on Quick Rest. Exception: Drained caused by the Necrotic Effect at 4–5 boxes requires divine healing specifically — arcane or other non-divine magical healing cannot clear it.

name: Enfeebled
effect: −2 to all Strength-based rolls (Attack, Athletics, Intimidate). Does not affect Agility or Toughness rolls. Lighter than Exhausted — the body is weak but the mind and movement are intact.
removed: Full Rest, or Heal DC 10.

name: Fascinated
effect: −2 to all rolls not directly related to the source of fascination. Cannot take actions with the Concentrate trait unless they target the source.
removed: source removed, hostile action against you or an ally, or Resist DC 12.

name: Invisible
effect: Cannot be seen by creatures relying on normal sight. All attacks against you have −4 to roll (attackers are effectively Blinded toward you). Your own attacks gain +4 vs unaware targets.
removed: end of effect, or taking any aggressive action — attacking or casting ends Invisible immediately.

name: Petrified
effect: Transformed to stone or rendered completely rigid. Cannot take any action. DR increases by +4 (the stone provides protection). Cannot be Broken by physical damage while Petrified — but box 15 may be reached when restored.
removed: dispel magic, Radiant Effect (3+ boxes), or specific counter-ritual.

name: Quickened
effect: Gain 1 extra Action per round. Once per round, may re-roll a failed Deflect at −2 (take the second result).
source: specific Powers, Haste effects, Boon Menu.
removed: end of scene, or the source effect ends.

name: Routed
effect: Psychological collapse — the character must flee or cower each round. Cannot take offensive actions. At the start of each turn, make a Morale check DC 12 to recover. On success, Routed ends. On failure, must spend all Actions fleeing or hiding.
removed: Morale check DC 12 (start of turn), or Inspire from ally.
notes: Renamed from “Broken (Psychology)” to avoid confusion with pool Broken.

name: Sickened
effect: −2 to all rolls and DCs. Cannot voluntarily eat, drink, or use consumables. Lighter than Poisoned — no per-round damage, no pool cost. Represents nausea, illness, or deep revulsion.
removed: Full Rest, or Heal DC 10.

name: Blessed
effect: Divine authority is fully present. All Spirit-based Powers gain the Authority Over Supernatural bonus (+1 effective Power Level) against ALL targets this scene, not just supernatural ones.
source: Radiant Effect (4–5 boxes), Channel DC 14, Bishop-level blessing.
removed: end of scene, or character commits an act contrary to the blessing’s source.

name: Braced
effect: Defensive stance hardened. DR +2 until end of next turn. Immune to knockback and push effects.
source: Guardian’s Hold the Line, Stone Skin power (active), Boon Menu.
removed: end of next turn, or character moves voluntarily.

name: Focused
effect: +2 to all Observe, Analyze, Knowledge, and Tactics rolls until end of scene. Unmark 1 Mana box on activation.
source: successful Tactics roll DC 12, Boon Menu.
removed: end of scene, or character takes Stamina damage — focus breaks under pain.

name: Hasted
effect: Speed and reactions dramatically enhanced. Gain 1 extra Action per round. Movement costs 0 extra Actions (Slowed cancels Hasted rather than both applying).
source: Force Effect (4–5 boxes, positive use), specific Powers, Boon Menu.
removed: end of scene, or 1 Stamina per round to maintain.

name: Inspired
effect: +2 to the next roll of any kind. Expended on use (one roll only). Additionally unmark 1 Mana box.
source: Inspire skill success (DC 10 grants Inspired to one ally), Lead DC 12 (grants to all allies in Close range).
removed: used on a roll, or end of scene.

name: Rallied
effect: Clears 1 Fear level immediately. +1 to all Spirit rolls until end of scene. If this clears Fear entirely, the character is immune to the Routed condition for 1 scene.
source: Inspire DC 12, Lead DC 12, completing a mission objective, Boon Menu.
removed: end of scene.

name: Resolute
effect: Immune to Frightened, Charmed, Confused, and Routed for 1 round.
source: Inspire DC 14, Boon Menu (Clarity on a Spirit roll), Radiant Effect (2+ boxes).
removed: end of round.

name: Cursed
effect: −2 to all rolls until the curse’s stated condition is met. Removed only by satisfying that condition or by Abjure DC 16.

name: Possessed
effect: Another will directs your actions. The GM controls you. Make a Willpower check vs DC 14 at the start of each of your turns to act freely for that round.

name: Withered
effect: Named pool maximum reduced by 2. Persists until a Restoration event or Full Rest in consecrated ground.

name: Phased
effect: Cannot be targeted by physical attacks and cannot make them. Magical and Psionic effects still reach you. Ends at the start of your next turn unless sustained.

name: Soul-Marked
effect: A named entity always knows your direction and rough distance. Removed only by Abjure DC 16 or the entity’s death.

name: Enthralled
effect: Cannot willingly act against a named person. Attempting it costs 1 Action and a Willpower check vs DC 13. Removed by Abjure DC 14 or the thrall-holder’s death.

name: Blighted
effect: All healing and pool restoration you receive is halved, rounded down. Removed by Restoration, or Survive DC 14 over a Full Rest.

name: Suppressed
effect: Names one Power Source (e.g. Suppressed (Arcane)). Abilities drawing from that source cannot be used.
removed: End of scene; a Restoration event, Dispel (Cast DC 14), or a Full Rest.
